principle: SVG is a working/presentation representation. Original CAD/PDF remains the preserved source.

routes.implementation: PyMuPDF vector path extraction + source-line exporter
routes.limitation: may omit annotations or PDF-specific graphics
SVG does not replace original DXF entity/layer authority

routes.implementation: external/local DWG decoder -> DXF -> TAKY DXF adapter -> SVG
routes.limitation: direct native DWG decode not implemented in current runtime

preserve_rule: Never discard original source after SVG conversion. Store source digest and conversion provenance.
comparison_rule: Use geometry/object checks where available; use edge/render checks only as supporting evidence.
